discovery.title: At an old steel site in Pittsburgh, bacteria evolved to survive—and eat—industrial pollution
discovery.summary: Across Appalachia and the Rust Belt region, including throughout the city of Pittsburgh, former industrial sites are being transformed into new neighborhoods, research centers and technology hubs.
